entry.title: CLT Features Support Manifold Steering, but Hold Only Partial Steering Signal
entry.content: tl;dr I continue work to extend the Goodfire lab's cyclical manifold methods to Anthropic's pre-trained CLT feature space on Gemma-2-2B.
